mainEntity.name: How does The Field Guide make money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some links are affiliate links. If you buy through one, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Every affiliate link is labelled next to where it appears.

mainEntity.name: Do affiliate links change the price I pay?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You pay the provider's normal price. Some partners, such as OneHomeschool, give a small discount when you use my code.

mainEntity.name: How do you choose which tools to cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: I cover tools that matter to the websites and businesses I build for. Each guide lists who a tool fits, who it does not fit, and what to check on the official site before paying.
